narrative.overview:
The site is a wayfinding system rather than a document or a gallery. A black band runs across the top like the header strip of a transit sign, the page beneath is a near-white sign ground, and every list is a stack of ruled rows on a full-width 12-column grid. One neo-grotesk in two weights does all the talking. The only color anywhere is a small solid bullet that says what kind of thing a row is: a Project, a Role, a Case study, or a Note. You always know where you are, what you are looking at, and where the next arrow goes.

Density is calm but not sparse: the frame runs to 96rem so a desktop is actually used, display type is set large and tight, and the directory rows carry date, title, summary, and a side label without any container around them. Depth is entirely flat. Hierarchy comes from scale, weight, and the 2px ink rules that head each section.

Night is not a dark theme bolted on; it is the same sign lit up. The band inverts to a pale bar, the ground goes near-black, and the Kind bullets brighten like lamps.
keyCharacteristics: Black sign band header and lit footer band; near-white ground between them.
One grotesk (Host Grotesk) at exactly two weights, 400 and 600; tabular figures for dates.
Color carries Kind and nothing else: four bullet colors, everything else is ink.
One row schema for every list: date, bullet with title and summary, side label, arrow.
Ruled rows, no cards, no shadows, no corners except the round bullet.
Motion is three things: one staggered rise, a title morph into Posts, a Kind-colored reading bar.

rules.name: The Color Means Kind Rule
rules.body: The four Kind colors appear only as a Kind's bullet, its hover line, its reading-progress bar, and its OG-card bullet. Nothing else on the site is colored: not links, not headings, not code, not diagrams, not focus rings. A row with no Kind (education) gets a hollow Slate ring instead of a bullet.

rules.name: The Ink-Only Code Rule
rules.body: Code is highlighted in ink steps only: keywords and function names bold, strings and numbers in Graphite, comments in Slate italic, on a transparent background. Drawn figures follow the same law: a hot path is shown by a heavier stroke (2.5 against 1 to 1.25), never by a hue; auxiliary parts are dashed Hairline.

rules.name: The Lit Sign Rule
rules.body: In dark mode the band inverts (pale band, dark band text) rather than disappearing into the ground. Every color token switches through `prefers-color-scheme`; nothing is hard-coded to one mode, including the favicon and drawn SVG figures.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: The grotesk is used at 400 and 600 only. Emphasis is 600; there is no light, medium, or bold. Italic is allowed (figure labels, a lone emphasized caption line) but adds no weight. The mono's 700 exists only for bold keywords in code.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: All text, including section heads and nav, is sentence case at normal tracking. Hierarchy comes from size and weight, never from uppercase or letterspacing.

rules.name: The One Row Rule
rules.body: Every list on the site is the same row: date, then bullet with title and summary, then a side label, then an arrow. Narrow rows stack these in a two-column grid (1.875rem bullet track, then content); wide rows lay them out as columns from lg (date 2, title and summary 7, side and arrow 3). New lists use this row; they do not get cards, tiles, or a new schema.

rules.name: The Flat Sign Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. If something needs emphasis, it gets a rule, a weight, or an ink fill, never a shadow or a card.

dos: Do use the one row schema (date, bullet with title and summary, side, arrow) for any new list.
Do reserve the four Kind colors for bullets, hover lines, the reading bar, and OG bullets.
Do set code and drawn figures in ink steps; mark a hot path with a heavier stroke (2.5) and auxiliary parts with dashed Hairline.
Do keep the grotesk at 400 and 600, sentence case, with tabular figures for dates and periods.
Do head sections with a 2px ink rule and divide rows with 1px Hairline rules.
Do keep motion to the staggered rise (0.9s, 70ms steps, from an already-legible state), the title morph (0.45s), and the reading bar, all behind `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do let the band invert at night and keep every color, including SVG figures and the favicon, mode-aware.
Do caption figures with plain text, no figure numbers.
donts: Don't color links, headings, code tokens, diagram nodes, or focus rings; color means Kind.
Don't add weights beyond 400 and 600, uppercase labels, or tracked-out small caps.
Don't wrap content in cards, add shadows, or round corners; the bullet is the only round shape.
Don't use dots for prose list markers; round marks belong to Kind.
Don't set text lighter than Slate (ink-3); its 5:1 contrast on the ground is the floor.
Don't add icon glyphs; the drawn arrow is the only icon, in its three directions.
